jobs.description:
The Global Payment Financial Services team oversees financial services across global markets, from solution and product design through partner collaboration, business operations, and market expansion.

Focused on local market needs, we develop tailored financial solutions for consumers and merchants, working closely with local regulators, industry partners, and cross-functional teams to grow the business while maintaining robust risk controls. The challenge is adapting products to local customer needs, regulatory requirements, and partner ecosystems in every market we enter.

You will help build financial services that are inclusive, reliable, and easy to use, in markets where the requirements differ substantially from one to the next.

Program Intern (Conversion-Oriented): for graduating students who are looking for full-time conversion as the primary objective.

The Global Payment Financial Services team oversees financial services across global markets, from solution and product design through partner collaboration, business operations, and market expansion.

Focused on market needs, we develop tailored financial solutions for consumers and merchants, working closely with regulators, industry partners, and cross-functional teams to grow the business while maintaining robust risk controls. The challenge is adapting products to customer needs, regulatory requirements, and partner ecosystems in every market we enter.

You will help build financial services that are inclusive, reliable, and easy to use, in markets where the requirements differ substantially from one to the next.

About The Team:
In line with the company’s globalization strategy and vision, the Global Payments team builds cross-border payment solutions that support ByteDance’s products and services around the world. As the business continues to grow rapidly, this is an exciting opportunity to work on impactful payment and FinTech products at global scale.
As a SEA BNPL Solutions Intern, you will support the team in exploring, building, and optimizing Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) solutions for Southeast Asia. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and gain hands-on experience in product strategy, market analysis, partner collaboration, and solution design.

As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short-term projects and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, professional environment.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth. Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals. Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities:
- Support the team in researching and refining BNPL product strategy, market opportunities, and roadmap priorities in Southeast Asia.
- Assist in designing, launching, and improving BNPL solutions within our payment platform and broader product ecosystem.
- Conduct market research on industry trends, customer behavior, competitors, and regulatory developments to identify product opportunities.
- Help analyze data and user feedback to support product decisions and improve user experience.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including legal, compliance, finance, engineering, design, marketing, and business teams to drive project execution.
- Support external partner discussions and coordination for product integration and rollout.
- Contribute to day-to-day product operations, documentation, and project follow-up.

Analyze data and user feedback to support product decisions and improve user experience.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including legal, compliance, finance, engineering, design, marketing, and business teams to drive project execution.
Support external partner discussions and coordination for product integration and rollout.
Contribute to day-to-day product operations, documentation, and project follow-up.
Minimum Qualification(s)
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Strong interest in payments, FinTech, eCommerce, lending, or consumer financial products.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems clearly.
- Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
- Eagerness to learn, strong sense of ownership, proactive attitude, comfort working in a fast-paced environment and ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Able to commit to an internship of at least 3 consecutive months, with availability of 3–4 days per week.
- Working proficiency in Mandarin (written and spoken), as the role requires regular collaboration with China-based product, engineering and business stakeholders and working with bilingual documentation and meetings.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Previous internship, project, or research experience in product management, strategy, consulting, finance, payments, or internet businesses is a plus, but not required.
- Familiarity with BNPL, lending, payments, or Southeast Asia markets is a plus.
- Experience with data analysis tools (such as Excel, SQL, Python, or similar) is a plus.
- Demonstrated curiosity, resilience, and ability to learn quickly in new business domains.
If you have any questions, please reach out to us at apac-earlycareers@bytedance.com

jobs.description:
About the Team:
The Inference Infrastructure team is the creator and open-source maintainer of AIBrix, a Kubernetes-native control plane for large-scale LLM inference. We are part of ByteDance’s Core Compute Infrastructure organization, responsible for designing and operating the platforms that power microservices, big data, distributed storage, machine learning training and inference, and edge computing across multi-cloud and global datacenters.

With ByteDance's rapidly growing businesses and a global fleet of machines running hundreds of millions of containers daily, we are building the next generation of cloud-native, GPU-optimized orchestration systems. Our mission is to deliver infrastructure that is highly performant, massively scalable, cost-efficient, and easy to use—enabling both internal and external developers to bring AI workloads from research to production at scale.

We are expanding our focus on LLM inference infrastructure to support new AI workloads, and are looking for engineers passionate about cloud-native systems, scheduling, and GPU acceleration. You'll work in a hyper-scale environment, collaborate with world-class engineers, contribute to the open-source community, and help shape the future of AI inference infrastructure globally.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

Responsibilities:
- Design and build large-scale, container-based cluster management and orchestration systems with extreme performance, scalability, and resilience.
- Architect next-generation cloud-native GPU and AI accelerator infrastructure to deliver cost-efficient and secure ML platforms.
- Collaborate across teams to deliver world-class inference solutions using vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and other LLM engines.
- Stay current with the latest advances in open source (Kubernetes, Ray, etc.), AI/ML and LLM infrastructure, and systems research; integrate best practices into production systems.
- Write high-quality, production-ready code that is maintainable, testable, and scalable.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a PhD degree in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Strong understanding of large model inference, distributed and parallel systems, and/or high-performance networking systems.
- Hands-on experience building cloud or ML infrastructure in areas such as resource management, scheduling, request routing, monitoring, or orchestration.
- Solid knowledge of container and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Go, Rust, Python, or C++).

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience contributing to or operating large-scale cluster management systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Ray).
- Experience with workload scheduling, GPU orchestration, scaling, and isolation in production environments.
- Hands-on experience with GPU programming (CUDA) or inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM).
- Familiarity with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their ML platforms (SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI).
- Strong knowledge of ML systems (Ray, DeepSpeed, PyTorch) and distributed training/inference platforms.
- Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across global, cross-functional teams.
Passion for system efficiency, performance optimization, and open-source innovation.

jobs.description:
Team Introduction
Our Content Delivery Network (CDN) team operates a hybrid platform that combines commercial CDN vendors with ByteDance’s proprietary edge network. This platform spans a large global footprint of Points of Presence (POPs) and supports edge services such as traffic acceleration, CDN caching, gaming, and more. We are looking for experienced reliability and performance engineers to help ensure the stability, reliability, and performance of our edge services and products running on this hybrid CDN platform. This role also involves driving performance optimization and developing innovative solutions to meet evolving business demands at the edge.

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and operate large-scale, highly distributed infrastructure. Our SREs are responsible for ensuring that these infrastructure services are reliable, fault-tolerant, scalable, and cost-efficient. In this role, you will manage complex systems at scale, including hyperscale data centers, public cloud infrastructure, global CDNs, and load balancers that process terabits of traffic per second. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into actionable plans and drive improvements in system design and operational processes.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.
Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities
- Architect and implement solutions that enable internal and external customers to leverage ByteDance’s globally scaled content delivery network.
- Build metrics, tools, automation, visualizations, and monitoring systems to support the operation and optimization of edge services.
- Develop procedures and workflows that improve efficiency, build trust, and ensure compliance across operational processes.
- Conduct vulnerability and capacity assessments, and develop disaster recovery strategies to ensure the high availability of global CDN services.
- Participate in technical operations and on-call rotations to respond to performance and reliability issues.

Minimum Qualification(s)
- Currently pursuing an Undergraduate Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
- Proficient in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, or Go, or scripting languages such as Shell and Python.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience operating in a multi-CDN environment.
- Experience with networking technologies such as TCP/IP, BGP, and DNS in carrier-grade environments; prior CDN experience is a plus.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to address real-world challenges in a fast-paced environment.
- Self-driven and able to take projects from concept through delivery.
- Experience designing, analyzing, and building automation and tools for large-scale systems.
- Experience developing and operating one or more of the following systems: OpenStack, Kubernetes, Nginx, IPVS, ELK Stack, Hadoop, or similar technologies.
